title: Map and inspect Automobile Service results
steps: In GIS, open the Automobile layer configuration and select Service under Test type.
Add the Service layer to display matching results as map points.
Select a map point to open its Service tests table.
Select a supported column heading, such as Test Time, to sort the displayed rows.
Enter a value in Filter shown tests to show matching rows.
Select a result with returned cell-neighbour data to view each neighbour in its labelled details table.
screenshotCaptions: Service is available under Test type in the Automobile layer configuration.
The Automobile Service layer is added and matching result markers are visible on the map.
The selected Service result opens a docked table with MSISDN, Test Time, Signal, Band, Service, Data Technology, PLMN and Serving Cell columns.
The Service tests table is sorted by Test Time in ascending order.
The Filter shown tests field contains 19:47:32 and the table shows the matching row.
The selected Service record shows separately labelled Cell Neighbour 1, 2 and 3 tables.
reason: Adds instructions for selecting the Automobile Service layer, viewing and exploring its mapped results, and reading returned neighbour details.
